classes.name: bankruptcy
classes.label: bankruptcy
classes.definition: credit event involving a change in state or condition in which a party becomes insolvent

classes.name: credit event
classes.label: credit event
classes.definition: event signifying a sudden change in credit standing, such as bankruptcy or a violation of a bond indenture or loan agreement, that raises doubts about the party's ability to meet current or future obligations

classes.name: cross default provision
classes.label: cross default provision
classes.definition: contract provision that triggers a default under one contract if the borrower defaults on another related obligation

classes.name: default event
classes.label: default event
classes.definition: credit event representing a failure to meet a contractual obligation, such as failure to repay a debt including interest or principal on a loan or security

classes.name: distressed ratings downgrade
classes.label: distressed ratings downgrade
classes.definition: credit event triggered when the credit rating of an obligation is downgraded to a distressed debt level

classes.name: downgrade
classes.label: downgrade
classes.definition: credit event triggered when the credit rating of a party or obligation is lowered

classes.name: entity-specific credit event
classes.label: entity-specific credit event
classes.definition: credit event that applies to a given legal person

classes.name: failure to pay
classes.label: failure to pay
classes.definition: default event that is triggered following any applicable grace period in which a payment obligation is missed

classes.name: failure to pay interest
classes.label: failure to pay interest
classes.definition: default event that where either an expected interest payment is missed altogether or the amount paid is less than the required amount

classes.name: failure to pay principal
classes.label: failure to pay principal
classes.definition: default event that where either an expected principal payment is missed altogether or the amount paid is less than the required amount

classes.name: filing for bankruptcy
classes.label: filing for bankruptcy
classes.definition: credit event that involves a request to a court to be recognized as bankrupt

classes.name: hard credit event
classes.label: hard credit event
classes.definition: default event that is not repairable

classes.name: installment default
classes.label: installment default
classes.definition: default event involving non-payment of several installment payments as scheduled in the terms of the agreement, or non-payment of a call by the beneficial owner

classes.name: interest obligation in light of default
classes.label: interest obligation in light of default
classes.definition: obligation in respect of default(s) in the performance of any payment obligation

classes.name: maturity extension
classes.label: maturity extension
classes.definition: credit event involving extension of payments beyond the original maturity date of the obligation

classes.name: moratorium
classes.label: moratorium
classes.definition: entity-specific credit event involving a temporary suspension of payments until related issues are resolved

classes.name: obligation acceleration
classes.label: obligation acceleration
classes.definition: credit event triggered when one or more reference obligations become immediately due and payable as a result of a default or covenant breach on the reference entity's other debt instruments, subject to a materiality threshold

classes.name: obligation default
classes.label: obligation default
classes.definition: credit event triggered as a result of an obligation-specific default

classes.name: obligation restructuring
classes.label: obligation restructuring
classes.definition: credit event that materially impacts an obligation, such as an interest rate reduction, principal reduction, deferral of interest or principal, change in priority ranking, or change in currency or composition of payment

classes.name: obligation-specific credit event
classes.label: obligation-specific credit event
classes.definition: credit event that relates to an individual credit agreement or debt instrument (reference obligation)

classes.name: repudiation
classes.label: repudiation
classes.definition: credit event involving the refusal to honor the terms of a contract

classes.name: soft credit event
classes.label: soft credit event
classes.definition: default event that is repairable

classes.name: write-down
classes.label: write-down
classes.definition: obligation-specific credit event whereby the book value of the obligation, such as the outstanding principal amount, is reduced

classes.name: credit inquiry
classes.label: credit inquiry
classes.definition: request from a lender to a credit repository to obtain information regarding a prospective borrower's creditworthiness

classes.name: credit inquiry type
classes.label: credit inquiry type
classes.definition: classifier indicating whether a credit inquiry is a result of a borrower's direct authorization or by some indirect means

classes.name: credit message
classes.label: credit message
classes.definition: notice on a credit report to alert a reviewer of special or exceptional information

classes.name: credit message type
classes.label: credit message type
classes.definition: classifier that categorizes credit messages

classes.name: credit quality
classes.label: credit quality
classes.definition: classifier for borrowers, rates, or holdings in the lending market with respect to the quality of the credit

classes.name: credit rating
classes.label: credit rating
classes.definition: assessment of creditworthiness of a borrower generally or with respect to a particular debt or financial obligation

classes.name: credit rating agency
classes.label: credit rating agency
classes.definition: rating agency that publishes reports assessing the creditworthiness of a borrower or legal entity, either generally or with respect to a specific obligation

classes.name: credit rating model
classes.label: credit rating model
classes.definition: algorithm for computing a credit rating

classes.name: credit score model type
classes.label: credit score model type
classes.definition: a type corresonding to a family of credit scoring algorithms sharing common characteristics

classes.name: credit rating scale
classes.label: credit rating scale
classes.definition: rating scale for assigning a credit rating to individual, entity, or instrument, including defining a set of codes or numeric scores and indicating how an assessment that is assigned a score based on that scale means

classes.name: credit report
classes.label: credit report
classes.definition: report describing the creditworthiness and related credit attributes of a borrower

classes.name: credit report category
classes.label: credit report category
classes.definition: classifier for credit reports, often available from multiple vendors

classes.name: credit report product
classes.label: credit report product
classes.definition: branded credit report offered in the marketplace

classes.name: credit tradeline
classes.label: credit tradeline
classes.definition: report derived from the transaction history of a credit account

classes.name: instrument credit rating
classes.label: instrument credit rating
classes.definition: investment credit rating that provides an opinion of creditworthiness of an instrument, typically with some relationship to the creditworthiness of the issuer(s)

classes.name: investment credit rating
classes.label: investment credit rating
classes.definition: credit rating that provides an opinion of creditworthiness of an investment, including but not limited to an instrument or organization

classes.name: organization credit rating
classes.label: organization credit rating
classes.definition: credit rating that provides an opinion of creditworthiness of an organization

classes.name: short term credit rating
classes.label: short term credit rating
classes.definition: credit rating that provides an opinion of the probability of an individual or organization going into default within a year

classes.name: accrual
classes.label: accrual
classes.definition: the process of accumulating interest or other income that has been earned but not paid

classes.name: accrued interest
classes.label: accrued interest
classes.definition: amount of interest that has been incurred, as of a specific date, on a loan or other financial obligation but has not yet been paid out

classes.name: amortization
classes.label: amortization
classes.definition: the process of reduction of debt or other costs through periodic charges to assets or liabilities, such as through principal payments on mortgages

classes.name: amortization schedule
classes.label: amortization schedule
classes.definition: schedule of periodic payments (repayment installments) that specify changes in the balance of the debt over time

classes.name: borrower
classes.label: borrower
classes.definition: party to a credit agreement that is obligated to repay the amount borrowed (principal) with interest and other fees according to the terms of the instrument

classes.name: borrower identification scheme
classes.label: borrower identification scheme
classes.definition: system for allocating identifiers to borrowers

classes.name: borrower identifier
classes.label: borrower identifier
classes.definition: sequence of characters, capable of uniquely identifying a borrower

classes.name: borrowing capacity
classes.label: borrowing capacity
classes.definition: upper bound on the total amount of money that a lender believes a party has the ability to repay an obligation when due, as of some point in time

classes.name: capital lease
classes.label: capital lease
classes.definition: lease that must be reflected on an organization's balance sheet as an asset and as a corresponding liability

classes.name: collateral
classes.label: collateral
classes.definition: something pledged as security to ensure fulfillment of an obligation to another party, to lend money, extend credit, or provision securities

classes.name: collateral value as of date
classes.label: collateral value as of date
classes.definition: appraised value of the collateral for an obligation as of a given date

classes.name: committed credit facility
classes.label: committed credit facility
classes.definition: credit facility that is a confirmed source of financing for the borrower, as long as the borrower meets the conditions of the agreement

classes.name: committed sub-facility
classes.label: committed sub-facility
classes.definition: contractually committed portion of a credit facility that is available to the borrower and may be associated with some specific collateral

classes.name: credit agreement
classes.label: credit agreement
classes.definition: contractual agreement in which a debtor receives something of value and typically agrees to repay the creditor by some date in the future, in some form (e.g., cash, securities, etc.), generally with interest

classes.name: credit agreement repaid at maturity
classes.label: credit agreement repaid at maturity
classes.definition: credit agreement in which accrued interest may be periodically repaid or paid at maturity, but principal is paid at maturity

classes.name: credit agreement repaid periodically
classes.label: credit agreement repaid periodically
classes.definition: credit agreement in which the principal and accrued interest may be periodically repaid or exchanged

classes.name: credit enhancement agreement
classes.label: credit enhancement agreement
classes.definition: collateral agreement that governs the exchange of collateral between parties to mitigate counterparty credit risk

classes.name: credit enhancement beneficiary
classes.label: credit enhancement beneficiary
classes.definition: party that benefits from the collateral or guarantee established under the agreement, i.e., that is protected against counterparty credit risk because the collateral or guarantee serves as security for the obligation(s) owed to them

classes.name: credit facility
classes.label: credit facility
classes.definition: credit agreement that allows the borrower to periodically take out money over an extended period of time rather than reapplying for a loan every time they need funds

classes.name: creditor
classes.label: creditor
classes.definition: a party to whom an obligation, such as an amount of money, or good, or performance of some service exists

classes.name: day-count convention
classes.label: day-count convention
classes.definition: a business recurrence interval convention that is used to calculate the number of days in an interest payment, which applies to the amount of accrued interest or the present value for debt instruments

classes.name: debt
classes.label: debt
classes.definition: obligation to pay something, such as an amount of money, good, service, or instrument

classes.name: debt terms
classes.label: debt terms
classes.definition: contract terms that specify the formal rights and obligations of borrower and lender under a contract in which funds are lent from the one party to the other

classes.name: debtor
classes.label: debtor
classes.definition: a party that owes a debt or other obligation to another party

classes.name: explicit contract event schedule
classes.label: explicit contract event schedule
classes.definition: schedule of events, including but not limited to payment events, rate reset events and others that will occur over the lifetime of the credit agreement

classes.name: fixed interest rate
classes.label: fixed interest rate
classes.definition: interest rate that does not fluctuate over the lifetime of a loan or other debt instrument

classes.name: floating interest rate
classes.label: floating interest rate
classes.definition: variable interest rate that is based on a specific index or benchmark rate

classes.name: full amortization
classes.label: full amortization
classes.definition: amortization in which the very last payment (which, if the schedule was calculated correctly, should be equal to all others) pays off all remaining principal and interest on the loan

classes.name: interest
classes.label: interest
classes.definition: the cost of using credit, or another's money, expressed as a rate per period of time, payable by a debtor to a creditor in consideration of the credit extended to the debtor

classes.name: interest calculation
classes.label: interest calculation
classes.definition: event reflecting the calculation of interest

classes.name: interest calculation schedule
classes.label: interest calculation schedule
classes.definition: regular, contract-specific schedule including the dates on which interest is calculated

classes.name: interest payment
classes.label: interest payment
classes.definition: event reflecting the actual payment of interest

classes.name: interest payment schedule
classes.label: interest payment schedule
classes.definition: regular, contract-specific schedule including the dates on which interest is due to be paid

classes.name: interest payment terms
classes.label: interest payment terms
classes.definition: contract terms for payment of interest on a debt

classes.name: interest rate reset
classes.label: interest rate reset
classes.definition: event reflecting a potential adjustment to an interest rate, typically corresponding to a change in the underlying benchmark interest rate or index specified in the contract

classes.name: interest rate reset schedule
classes.label: interest rate reset schedule
classes.definition: regular, contract-specific schedule including the dates on which a rate reset, and corresponding actual rate, is recalculated

classes.name: interest rate setting event
classes.label: interest rate setting event
classes.definition: event on which an initial rate for a given contract is set, which may be relative the the occurrence of some other contract lifecycle event, such as the execution date

classes.name: lease
classes.label: lease
classes.definition: credit agreement permitting the use of real estate, equipment or another asset, such as a vehicle, by the owner of that asset (the lessor) to a user (the lessee) for a specific period of time in return for payment as specified in the agreement

classes.name: lender
classes.label: lender
classes.definition: a party that extends credit or money to a borrower with the expectation of being repaid, usually with interest

classes.name: managed interest rate
classes.label: managed interest rate
classes.definition: variable interest rate charged by a financial institution for borrowing that is not prescribed as a margin over base rate but is set from time to time by the institution

classes.name: motor vehicle lease
classes.label: motor vehicle lease
classes.definition: lease of a motor vehicle for a fixed period of time at an agreed amount of money

classes.name: negative amortization
classes.label: negative amortization
classes.definition: amortization in which the payments made do not cover the interest due

classes.name: non-physical collateral
classes.label: non-physical collateral
classes.definition: asset pledged as collateral that is a financial asset, rather than physical asset

classes.name: partial amortization
classes.label: partial amortization
classes.definition: amortization in which the very last payment the last payment due may be a large balloon payment of all remaining principal and interest

classes.name: physical collateral
classes.label: physical collateral
classes.definition: asset pledged as collateral that has a material form, i.e., is a physical asset of the obligor

classes.name: principal
classes.label: principal
classes.definition: with respect to a debt: the value of an obligation, such as a bond or loan, raised and that must be repaid at maturity; for investments: the original amount of money invested, separate from any associated interest, dividends or capital gains

classes.name: principal payment
classes.label: principal payment
classes.definition: event reflecting the actual payment of some amount of the principal of a debt

classes.name: principal payment schedule
classes.label: principal payment schedule
classes.definition: regular, contract-specific schedule including the dates on which some percentage or all of the principal is due to be (re)paid

classes.name: principal repayment terms
classes.label: principal repayment terms
classes.definition: contract terms that specify requirements for repayment of the principal

classes.name: projected contract event schedule
classes.label: projected contract event schedule
classes.definition: schedule of events, including but not limited to anticipated payment events, rate reset events and others that are expected to occur over the lifetime of the contract

classes.name: rate reset time of day
classes.label: rate reset time of day
classes.definition: time of day that an interest rate is reset, as indicated by some interest rate authority or market data provider

classes.name: retail credit facility
classes.label: retail credit facility
classes.definition: credit facility that is a loan or line of credit used by retailers and real estate companies

classes.name: revolving line of credit
classes.label: revolving line of credit
classes.definition: credit facility that enables the borrower to withdraw funds, repay, and withdraw again

classes.name: security agreement
classes.label: security agreement
classes.definition: collateral agreement that grants a financial interest in some collateral to a party that is not an owner of that collateral, specifying terms including relative duties and rights, over and above those specified in the primary contract, regarding the disposition of the asset used as collateral

classes.name: sub-facility
classes.label: sub-facility
classes.definition: portion of a credit facility extended to the borrower for some purpose, possibly per some schedule specified in the facility

classes.name: uncommitted credit facility
classes.label: uncommitted credit facility
classes.definition: credit facility that has yet to be confirmed as a source of financing for the borrower

classes.name: uncommitted sub-facility
classes.label: uncommitted sub-facility
classes.definition: sub-facility that has yet to be confirmed as a source of financing for the borrower

classes.name: variable interest rate
classes.label: variable interest rate
classes.definition: an interest rate that is allowed to vary over the maturity of a loan or other debt instrument

classes.name: collateralized guaranty
classes.label: collateralized guaranty
classes.definition: guaranty that takes the form of some asset that is pledged by a borrower to a lender (usually in return for a loan)

classes.name: government guaranty
classes.label: government guaranty
classes.definition: guaranty provided by a government entity, such as for a government-backed security

classes.name: guarantor
classes.label: guarantor
classes.definition: party that guarantees, endorses, or provides indemnity for some obligation on behalf of some other party

classes.name: guaranty
classes.label: guaranty
classes.definition: commitment whereby something is formally assured if a party with primary liability fails to perform

classes.name: insurance-backed guaranty
classes.label: insurance-backed guaranty
classes.definition: guaranty that is realized as an insurance policy

classes.name: insurance policy
classes.label: insurance policy
classes.definition: contract that (1) puts an indemnity cover into effect, (2) serves as a legal evidence of the insurance agreement, (3) sets out the exact terms on which the indemnity cover has been provided, and (4) states associated information such as the (a) specific risks and perils covered, (b) duration of coverage, (c) amount of premium, (d) mode of premium payment, and (e) deductibles, if any

classes.name: insurer
classes.label: insurer
classes.definition: financial service provider that issues an insurance policy

classes.name: joint guaranty
classes.label: joint guaranty
classes.definition: guaranty provided by at least two parties, jointly and severally

classes.name: letter of credit
classes.label: letter of credit
classes.definition: letter from a bank or other creditworthy institution guaranteeing that a buyer's payment to a seller will be received on time and for the correct amount

classes.name: letter of credit guaranty
classes.label: letter of credit guaranty
classes.definition: guaranty that takes the form of a letter of credit, i.e., a document issued by a bank guaranteeing the payment up to a stated amount for a specified period

classes.name: negative pledge
classes.label: negative pledge
classes.definition: guaranty whereby the issuer will not pledge any assets if doing so would result in less security for lender(s) or investor(s)

classes.name: policyholder
classes.label: policyholder
classes.definition: counterparty to and typically owner of an insurance policy

classes.name: priority level
classes.label: priority level
classes.definition: relative ranking that a guaranty has in the context of a contract, for example for a credit enhancement priority

edges.name: has default interest compounding basis
edges.label: has default interest compounding basis
edges.definition: indicates the basis on which default interest is to be calculated, as a period of time
domain: interest obligation in light of default

edges.name: has default threshold amount
edges.label: has default threshold amount
edges.definition: specifies an amount of money that triggers a failure to pay, repudiation/moratorium or restructuring event

edges.name: has grace period
edges.label: has grace period
edges.definition: window following any payment due date during which a party must fulfill its obligations before a failure to pay credit event occurs

edges.name: concerns party
edges.label: concerns party
edges.definition: indicates the party for which something is being or has been requested

edges.name: has coverage period
edges.label: has coverage period
edges.definition: relates something (e.g. a credit report or insurance policy) to the specific time period that it covers

edges.name: watch direction
edges.label: watch direction
edges.definition: indicates direction in which an investment credit rating is expected to move in cases where that rating is on watch

edges.name: watch outlook
edges.label: watch outlook
edges.definition: indicates the expected outlook for the rated entity

edges.name: governs payment of
edges.label: governs payment of
edges.definition: links contractual terms embedded in a contract, such as interest or repayment terms to the element those terms apply to

edges.name: has accrual basis
edges.label: has accrual basis
edges.definition: identifies the convention that defines how interest accrues on something, that is the number of days in a month and days in a year that are counted when performing interest accrual calculations

edges.name: has amount of credit extended
edges.label: has amount of credit extended
edges.definition: specifies the gross amount of credit that has been provided to the borrower as of a given point in time with respect to a specific agreement (e.g. for line of credit)

edges.name: has available amount
edges.label: has available amount
edges.definition: indicates an amount of money available for an individual or organization to borrow

edges.name: has borrower
edges.label: has borrower
edges.definition: relates a contract, such as a debt instrument or credit agreement, to one or more parties that are incurring the debt

edges.name: has compounding frequency
edges.label: has compounding frequency
edges.definition: the frequency at which interest is added to the principal of the debt over the course of the agreement

edges.name: has credit limit
edges.label: has credit limit
edges.definition: specifies the maximum amount of credit that may be borrowed with respect to a specific agreement (e.g. for line of credit)

edges.name: has debt amount
edges.label: has debt amount
edges.definition: indicates the monetary amount of the debt

edges.name: has denomination
edges.label: has denomination
edges.definition: the face value of currency units, coins, or securities

edges.name: has final interest payment date
edges.label: has final interest payment date
edges.definition: the date on which the last interest payment is due

edges.name: has initial exchange date
edges.label: has initial exchange date
edges.definition: indicates the specific date when the initial exchange of assets or funds takes place

edges.name: has initial interest accrual date
edges.label: has initial interest accrual date
edges.definition: the date from which interest begins to accrue

edges.name: has initial interest payment date
edges.label: has initial interest payment date
edges.definition: the date on which the first interest payment is due

edges.name: has initial principal payment date
edges.label: has initial principal payment date
edges.definition: the date on which the first payment against the principal is due

edges.name: has interest payment day
edges.label: has interest payment day
edges.definition: the day of the month on which interest payments must be made on the debt

edges.name: has interest payment frequency
edges.label: has interest payment frequency
edges.definition: the frequency at which interest payments must be made on the debt

edges.name: has interest rate
edges.label: has interest rate
edges.definition: relates something, such as an agreement, or debt instrument, to the rate (typically annual) of interest that is to be paid by the debtor to the creditor on the debt

edges.name: has interest rate cap
edges.label: has interest rate cap
edges.definition: relates something, such as an agreement, or debt instrument, to the upper bound (ceiling) rate (typically annual) of interest on variable-rate debt that is to be paid by the debtor to the creditor on the debt

edges.name: has lender
edges.label: has lender
edges.definition: relates a contract, such as a debt instrument or credit agreement, to one or more parties that are financing the debt

edges.name: has maturity date
edges.label: has maturity date
edges.definition: indicates the date on which the principal amount of an instrument is due to be repaid to the investor and interest or coupon payments stop, and/or the date on which the instrument may be redeemed

edges.name: has maximum advance amount
edges.label: has maximum advance amount
edges.definition: specifies the ceiling on the amount of credit that can be drawn by the borrower in a single request with respect to a specific agreement (e.g. for line of credit) within the specified credit limit

edges.name: has time to maturity
edges.label: has time to maturity
edges.definition: indicates the lifespan of credit agreement or offering, from the date of issuance to the scheduled maturity date

edges.name: has outstanding amount
edges.label: has outstanding amount
edges.definition: indicates an amount of money representing the principal, interest, or other amount owed at a specific point in time

edges.name: has principal
edges.label: has principal
edges.definition: indicates the face value of an obligation, such as a bond or loan, that must be repaid at maturity, i.e., the base amount raised by a mortgage or other debt instrument

edges.name: has principal payment day
edges.label: has principal payment day
edges.definition: the day of the month on which payments on the principal must be made

edges.name: has principal payment frequency
edges.label: has principal payment frequency
edges.definition: the frequency at which payments on the principal must be made

edges.name: has principal repayment date
edges.label: has principal repayment date
edges.definition: relates an instrument to the date by which the principal must be repaid in full

edges.name: is amortization of
edges.label: is amortization of
edges.definition: links the process of reduction of debt or other costs through periodic charges to the relevant asset or liability

edges.name: is based on
edges.label: is based on
edges.definition: relates something to something else on which it rests, or that supports it in some way

edges.name: is collateralization of
edges.label: is collateralization of
edges.definition: relates some collateral to an agreement pledging the asset as security

edges.name: is collateralized by
edges.label: is collateralized by
edges.definition: relates an agreement to an asset pledged as security

edges.name: is interest on
edges.label: is interest on
edges.definition: links a monetary amount that is the cost of using credit to the debt that it applies to

edges.name: is owed
edges.label: is owed
edges.definition: links a creditor to a debt that is outstanding and payable to them

edges.name: is owed by
edges.label: is owed by
edges.definition: links a debt to the party that owes it

edges.name: is owed to
edges.label: is owed to
edges.definition: links a debt to the party to which it is payable

edges.name: is principal of
edges.label: is principal of
edges.definition: links the value of a debt, excluding any interest or other costs of using credit, to the debt that it applies to

edges.name: owes
edges.label: owes
edges.definition: links a party to a debt that they owe

edges.name: has guaranteed amount
edges.label: has guaranteed amount
edges.definition: relates the guaranty to the monetary amount guaranteed

edges.name: has guarantor
edges.label: has guarantor
edges.definition: relates the guarantor to the contract for which they are providing a guaranty

edges.name: has guarantor party
edges.label: has guarantor party
edges.definition: indicates a party that guarantees, endorses, or provides indemnity for some obligation on its behalf

edges.name: has priority level
edges.label: has priority level
edges.definition: relates a guaranty to some relative ranking that the guaranty has in the context of the contract, for example for a credit enhancement priority

edges.name: is guaranteed by
edges.label: is guaranteed by
edges.definition: relates guaranty to the contract guarantor, i.e., to the legal person providing the guaranty

edges.name: is guarantor of
edges.label: is guarantor of
edges.definition: identifies a party over which a guarantor has some measure of control by virtue of the guarantee

attributes.name: involves multiple events
attributes.label: involves multiple events
attributes.definition: indicates that the restructuring spans more than one credit event

attributes.name: is default interest applicable
attributes.label: is default interest applicable
attributes.definition: indicates whether a party that defaults in the performance of any payment obligation is, to the extent permitted by law and the applicable agreement, required to pay interest (before as well as after judgment) on the overdue amount to the other party on demand in the same currency as such overdue amount, for the period from (and including) the original due date for payment to (but excluding) the date of actual payment
domain: interest obligation in light of default

attributes.name: is grace period extendable
attributes.label: is grace period extendable
attributes.definition: indicates whether or not the grace period may be extended, which may be jurisdiction specific

attributes.name: has anticipated number of payments
attributes.label: has anticipated number of payments
attributes.definition: specifies the number of payments promised per the terms of the contract over the lifetime of the contract assuming all payments are made
